professional_summary: BI Solutions Architect with 5+ years of experience designing and delivering end-to-end business intelligence solutions - from raw data ingestion through pipeline architecture to the executive-facing dashboards that drive decisions. What makes an architect different from a developer is the ability to see the whole system: I design the data model, build the pipeline, govern the semantic layer, and deliver the dashboard, all as a coherent and maintainable whole. At Austal USA, I architected the entire BI platform for a $2B+ Navy shipbuilding program - designing data contracts across 20+ source systems, building containerized ETL infrastructure that processes 2M+ records daily, and delivering a real-time KPI layer that reduced material waste by 30% and cut reporting overhead by 35%. I translate business requirements into technical architecture, and technical outputs into business value.
